'''Virtual Set 13''' is a Players Committee virtual expansion from the 2014 Reset onward. It was released 9 November 2020. These are not Decipher cards.

Current virtual cards are maintained by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee. Printable slips are published with each set.

| [[File:V13-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif|200px|link=Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe (V)]] || [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe (V)|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi/Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe (V)]] || [[Objective|Objective]] || R || 0 || Deploy Vader's Castle, [Set 13] Visage Of The Emperor, and a [Cloud City] site with exactly one [Dark Side]. {For} remainder of game, you may not deploy characters except bounty hunters, droids, and Imperials. Where you have an Inquisitor, your total battle destiny is +1 (+2 if with a 'Hatred' card). Inquisitors are destiny +1. {While} this side up, once per turn, may deploy a [Cloud City] or Malachor battleground site from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. {Flip} this card if Vader is at a battleground site unless Luke, a Jedi, or a Padawan at a battleground site. Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe: {While} this side up, you lose no Force from Visage Of The Emperor.
